spans.s:
फेर फेर, अस्, m. (an onomatopoetic word;
cf. फेट्, फेत्), a jackal.

फेरल फेरल, N. of a place; (perhaps
wrongly for केरल.)

फेरव फे-रव, अस्, m. (fr. फे onomato-
poetic + रव), a jackal; a Rākṣasa, a goblin, a
demon; (अस्, आ, अम्), fraudulent, crafty, a rogue, a
cheat; malicious, noxious, injurious.
